lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba8Hg4Mo4O24 (reduced formula Ba2HgMoO6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Hg and Mo centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ba adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Hg and Mo octahedra is observed, alongside face-sharing between Ba polyhedra and both Hg and Mo octahedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
